Welcome!

Yibin Shen | 沈艺彬

I'm currently a second-year PhD student in Spark lab @ HKUST, under the supervision of Prof. Zili Meng. I obtained my bachelor's degree in Computer Science and Technology from Southeast University in 2024, where I was fortunate to work with Prof. Wenjia Wu.
My research interests broadly lie in the areas of wireless networking, video streaming and system for AI.
